topic: SSO login lockout after enabling SAML group mappings (Okta)
product_area: Account management / SAML SSO group mappings
environment: SCIM provisioning being enabled in a parent org
Password login enabled for all users in the org
symptom_pattern: After the customer tried to enable SCIM provisioning and SAML group mappings, users were locked out of the org. Login showed 'unknown user. there are no mapped roles for this user.' All admins used SSO, so none could log in to disable group mappings.
root_cause: The Okta SAML app was missing the Group Attribute Statement, so no group attributes were sent to Datadog. With group mappings enabled and no matching roles, Datadog removed all roles from the user's account. This was a group mapping problem, not a SCIM problem.
resolution_path: Asked for the exact error message to tell whether the problem came from SCIM or group mappings
Identified it as a group mapping issue: with no matching roles, group mapping removes all roles from the account
Suggested that another admin log in with username and password, disable group mappings, and restore permissions
Confirmed password login was enabled org-wide and pointed to the 'Forgot Password?' workflow for users without a password
Advised the customer to change the Okta configuration to send the group attributes by adding the missing Group Attribute Statement: member_of | Unspecified | matchesRegex .*
Confirmed the customer could log in again
info_needed: Exact error message shown at login
Whether password login is enabled for the org's users

qa_pairs.tse_question: Is there a specific error message you're seeing, so we can tell whether this is SCIM or group mappings?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: They saw an 'unknown user, no mapped roles' error and said they had mapped the role via UUID but something was wrong.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Suggested having another admin log in with username and password to disable group mappings.
qa_pairs.customer_answer: They said all of their admins use SSO.

evidence: unknown user. there are no mapped roles for this user.

tse_approach.summary: The engineer asked for the exact error to separate SCIM from group mapping, then explained the behavior behind the lockout and gave a workaround using password login. They then guided the customer to fix the missing Okta group attribute statement and confirmed login worked.
steps: Greeted the customer and reviewed the account and existing tickets
Asked for the specific error message
Diagnosed the issue as group mapping rather than SCIM and explained why roles were removed
Recommended password login by another admin to disable group mappings and restore permissions
Checked the org settings and confirmed password login was enabled for all users
Explained the 'Forgot Password?' workflow for users with no password set
Advised the Okta change to add the missing Group Attribute Statement
Confirmed the customer could log in and marked the ticket for solve
key_questions: Is there a specific error message you're seeing, so we can tell whether this is SCIM or group mappings?
communication: Explained why the lockout happened (no matching roles causes group mapping to remove all roles). Gave a clear workaround. Checked the org's password login setting before answering the customer's objection that everyone uses SSO. Gave the exact attribute statement value to configure.
